heading: Our Courses
subtitle: More than Qur'an — a complete Islamic education designed to deepen your understanding and strengthen your connection with Allah ﷻ

courses.title: Sabeel ul Jannah
courses.description: Comprehensive 2.5-year Quranic course covering Tajweed, Word-by-Word Translation & Tafseer of the Holy Quran, Tafheem Us Sunnah Hadith series, Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Islamic Fiqh, Personality Development, and Home & Time Management Skills.

courses.title: Nurun Ala Nur
courses.description: Advanced course for graduates of comprehensive Quran Tafseer (such as Sabeel ul Jannah). Spans 140 working days covering Khulasa-e-Quran (Quran Summary), Advanced Tajweed, Seerah of Nabi ﷺ, Mukhtasir Sahih Al-Bukhari, Teaching Techniques of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and Character Grooming (Islah-ul-Quloob).

courses.title: Seerah Course
courses.description: An in-depth, inspiring study of the blessed life, sublime character, and prophetic methodology of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Exploring historical events, moral lessons, and their practical application to contemporary personal, family, and home life.

courses.title: Al Lulu Wal Marjaan
courses.description: Pearls and coral — a two-part course of selected ahadith, their meanings, and practical wisdom for family life, kindness and worship.

courses.title: Tafseer & Hadith
courses.description: Verse-by-verse explanation of the Qur'an woven together with the authentic Sunnah — so students understand what Allah says and how the Prophet ﷺ lived it.

courses.title: Arabic Grammar
courses.description: Arabic grammar is built into every lesson so students can unlock the Qur'an's own language — understanding root words, verb forms and sentence structures that reveal deeper meaning.

courses.title: Tajweed & Quranic Vocabulary
courses.description: Master the art of proper Quranic recitation with precise pronunciation rules and expand your understanding of Quranic vocabulary to connect more deeply with each word you recite.

courses.title: Ambassadors of Islam
courses.description: An empowering course equipping students to become confident ambassadors of Islamic knowledge, equipped to share the beauty of Islam with wisdom and grace.
